text:
Mina: quick note — kicked off onboarding for saffron_v1 embeddings. ran wiki-mini and prod-catalog holdouts; trying float16, int8 (global and per-channel planned), and int4 (prototype).
Raj: baseline comparators?
Mina: compared to heron-embed-v1 (fp16) and albatross-compact (PQ). results summary below.
Mina: ```
# eval command
python eval_embeddings.py \
  --model saffron_v1 \
  --quant {none,int8,int4} \
  --datasets wiki-mini,prod-catalog \
  --k 1,5,10 \
  --metrics recall@k,silhouette,umap
```
Mina: wiki-mini recall: saffron fp16 R@1=0.83 R@5=0.94 R@10=0.96; saffron int8 R@1=0.79 R@5=0.92 R@10=0.95; saffron int4 R@1=0.72 R@5=0.86 R@10=0.90; heron fp16 R@1=0.84 R@5=0.95 R@10=0.97
Elaine: int8 looks within tolerance; int4 is noticeably worse. silhouette (cosine): fp16=0.41, int8=0.36, int4=0.24
Mina: NN distance means: pos mean cosine fp16=0.78 int8=0.75 int4=0.68. negatives shift small.
Omar: did you check short-doc sensitivity? tokenization can amplify quant noise.
Mina: prod-catalog is worse: fp16 R@1=0.71 int8=0.67 int4=0.59. short queries amplify drop.
Elaine: can we try per-channel symmetric int8 or asymmetric + KL? preserve top layers?
Mina: plan: 1) run per-channel int8 + asymmetric scaling (today). 2) rerank top-10 float16 candidates through fp16 encoder to estimate regressed fraction (tomorrow). 3) perf sweep @eng-runtime for int8 configs if quality ok.
Eng-bot: perf-sweep queued: saffron_v1 int8 configs (5 runs). https://ci.internal/runs/3421 :gear: 
Mina: small calibration note — bump similarity threshold ~+0.03 for prod-catalog when using int8 to restore precision without big recall loss.
Raj: error breakdown?
Mina: dug into failures: ~12% near-paraphrase misses, ~5% duplicate-id/anchor leakage, remaining are true regressions vs heron.
Elaine: actionable. attach eval logs + 10 sample query/nearest pairs in PR.
Mina: will open PR with recommended quant profile, threshold delta, and attach logs + sample pairs. cc: @eng-runtime @qa-team :thumbsup:
